report_name: Ransomware Hits Winnipeg Hospital's Building Systems

identities.name: Health Sciences Centre (HSC) Winnipeg
identities.description: Manitoba's largest hospital, which suffered a ransomware attack impacting its operational technology (OT) systems, including HVAC, elevators, and physical access controls, discovered on August 10, 2026.

identities.name: Cancer Care Manitoba
identities.description: A healthcare provider in Manitoba affected by the ransomware attack on Health Sciences Centre Winnipeg's operational systems.

identities.name: Shared Health
identities.description: The provincial health authority for Manitoba that managed the public response and investigation into the ransomware attack at HSC Winnipeg.

indicators.name: Suspicious IT to OT Network Traffic
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious IT to OT Network Traffic
id: 2b1a9c8d-e3f4-4a5b-8c6d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: 'Monitors for unusual connections from a general IT network to a sensitive OT network using protocols like RDP, SMB, or WinRM, which could indicate lateral movement.'
references:
  - https://winnipeg.citynews.ca/2026/08/17/health-sciences-centre-winnipeg-ransomware-attack-update/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-18
tags:
  - attack.t1021
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    src_ip_zone: 'it_network' # This is a placeholder and needs to be adapted to the specific environment
    dst_ip_zone: 'ot_network' # This is a placeholder and needs to be adapted to the specific environment
    dst_port:
      - 3389 # RDP
      - 445 # SMB
      - 5985 # WinRM HTTP
      - 5986 # WinRM HTTPS
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic from IT to OT environments using protocols commonly leveraged for lateral movement, as suggested in the article's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Potential Network Tunneling Tool Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Network Tunneling Tool Execution
id: f9e8d7c6-b5a4-4987-6543-210987fedcba
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the execution of plink.exe or chisel.exe, which are tools often used by attackers to create tunnels between network segments.'
references:
  - https://winnipeg.citynews.ca/2026/08/17/health-sciences-centre-winnipeg-ransomware-attack-update/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-18
tags:
  - attack.t1572
  - attack.command_and_control
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\plink.exe'
      - '\chisel.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of plink.exe or chisel.exe, tools mentioned in the report as being used by attackers to create network tunnels.

indicators.name: Attempted Mapping of OT Administrative Share
indicators.pattern:
title: Attempted Mapping of OT Administrative Share
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects attempts to map an administrative share (C$) on a remote server, which could indicate lateral movement towards an OT server.'
references:
  - https://winnipeg.citynews.ca/2026/08/17/health-sciences-centre-winnipeg-ransomware-attack-update/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-18
tags:
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_net:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' use '
      - '\\'
      - '\C$'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity.
indicators.description: Detects command-line patterns for mapping administrative shares, a technique suggested for hunting precursor activity related to lateral movement to OT servers.
